reading: OneFootball reports that RB Leipzig boss Martín Demichelis praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Champions League tie between Real Madrid and Leipzig at the Bernabéu. Yardbarker and Yahoo repeat this headline, noting Demichelis's high regard for Diomande before the match. Goal.com reports separately that Demichelis insists Franco Mastantuono is built for Real Madrid despite his loan spell at Fiorentina, stating he needs time to develop.
